multi-manifest:
apiVersion: geass.geass.dev/v1alpha1
kind: GeassCluster
metadata:
  name: default
  namespace: geass-system
spec:
  version: v1
  serverURL: https://203.0.113.1:6443
  tokenSecretRef:
    name: geass-token
    namespace: geass-system
  addons:
    longhorn:
      enabled: true
    logging:
      enabled: true
    certManager:
      acmeEmail: "ops@example.com"
  network:
    multiSite: true
multi-server-config:
flannel-backend: wireguard-native
flannel-external-ip: true
kubelet-arg:
- container-log-max-size=50Mi
- container-log-max-files=5
node-external-ip: 203.0.113.1
secrets-encryption: true
tls-san:
- 203.0.113.1
single-manifest:
apiVersion: geass.geass.dev/v1alpha1
kind: GeassCluster
metadata:
  name: default
  namespace: geass-system
spec:
  version: v1
  serverURL: https://10.0.0.5:6443
  tokenSecretRef:
    name: geass-token
    namespace: geass-system
  addons:
    longhorn:
      enabled: true
    logging:
      enabled: true
    certManager:
      acmeEmail: "ops@example.com"
